newsitem.title: PERU: Mediator says Peru hostages number 400.
newsitem.headline: Mediator says Peru hostages number 400.

text.p: The number of hostages held by Peruvian rebels at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima is about 400, Canadian ambassador Anthony Vincent, mediating between rebels and the Peruvian government, said on Thursday.
"There are about 400 people in there. They are packed in," Vincent told a news conference.
Previously the number of hostages was believed to be closer to 500.
A letter faxed early on Wednesday from within the residence to family members of hostages and signed by captives had said the rebels were holding 490 men.
The guerrillas, who seized the building on Tuesday night, have threatened to kill all the hostages if 400 to 500 of their jailed comrades are not released.
